messages:
chao: Heads up — I'm about to push an egress lockdown policy to prod VPCs that will only allow whitelisted S3 endpoints and our PrivateLink endpoints. Rolling in 30m. :lock:

infra-bot: Deploy plan created: egress-policy/prod v2 -> staging -> prod. Preview: https://ci.internal/reports/egress-2026-03-17

eva: Quick Q — any chance this will affect the GPU fleet pulling model artifacts? we've seen flakes earlier when S3 endpoints changed.

ben: Yeah saw a few job failures on canaries after the last endpoint tweak. Error looks like an encrypt/decrypt permission issue from KMS when instance tried to fetch artifact: 
```
2026-03-17T09:12:04Z ERROR model-fetcher: failed to download s3://redwood-models/eu-west-1/llama-7b/weights.tar.gz 
caused by: AccessDenied: User: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/redwood-prod-gpu/instance-abc is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource: arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01 
```

alice: That looks like the new VPC endpoint policy blocked STS -> role assumption, or our kms key policy doesn't include the assumed-role principal. Two parts to check: endpoint policy + KMS key policy.

chao: I only planned to restrict S3 prefix list and block public S3. Not touch KMS — but this error implies the GPU nodes use a cross-account role or assume a role that the key policy doesn't allow.

ben: Also noticed the VPC endpoints in eu-west-1 are using a different prefix-list id than us-east-1, so the whitelist might not match the actual bucket endpoints there. That could block direct S3 traffic and force a multipart download via NAT (which is disallowed now).

security-bot: Audit flag triggered: config-rule S3-EGRESS-HARDEN triggered 3m ago for prod-eu VPC. Recording finding ID: FINDING-2026-03-17-1873. Please attach remediation plan.

alice: Proposed quick patch (low-risk):
1) Add the S3 gw endpoint policy to allow our model-artifact bucket ARNs and STS AssumeRole endpoints.
2) Update KMS key policy to explicitly allow the assumed role principal for kms:Decrypt.
3) Add a canary tag to 5 GPU nodes and run model fetch test.

Terraform snippet for endpoint policy (apply to aws_vpc_endpoint):
```hcl
resource "aws_vpc_endpoint" "s3_gw" {
  vpc_id       = var.vpc_id
  service_name = "com.amazonaws.eu-west-1.s3"
  route_table_ids = var.route_table_ids
  policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [
      { Effect = "Allow" , Principal = "*", Action = "s3:*", Resource = ["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-models*"] }
    ]
  })
}
```

alice: And KMS patch (simplified):
```json
{
  "Sid": "AllowRedwoodProdDecrypt",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": ["arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-prod-gpu"]},
  "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:DescribeKey"],
  "Resource": "*"
}
```

eva: If we change KMS policy, will that force a key rotation or re-encrypt step? want to avoid mass re-encrypts during business hours.

ben: No, updating the key policy doesn't rotate the key. Rotation only happens if you enable automatic rotation or create a new key. But be careful about cross-account principals.

chao: Another potential quick workaround: point the GPU nodes to our internal artifact mirror (s3://redwood-geo-mirror/eu-west-1) which is already allowed in the egress policy. That buys time while we patch KMS/policies.

alice: Good idea. Plan: 1) revert the strict deny for non-whitelisted S3 traffic in prod-eu and put in a temporary allow for redwood-models and redwood-geo-mirror, 2) apply KMS policy update, 3) run canary model pulls on 5 nodes, 4) re-enable strict deny.

security-bot: Remediation steps logged. Will add exception window (30m) for FINDING-2026-03-17-1873. Please attach runbook link after patch.

ben: Monitoring to watch: Datadog metric `gpu.model-fetch.failures`, CloudTrail event `Decrypt`, and VPC flow logs for denied S3 traffic. I'll wire a temporary dashboard.

chao: Ok schedule: start rollback-of-deny at 2026-03-17T10:00Z, KMS patch at 10:10Z, canary run 10:20Z, full re-enable 10:40Z. If gpu.model-fetch.failures spike > 5/min, abort and revert.

eva: I'll be on call for the window. Ping if anything unexpected. :phone:

alice: I'll open a PR to terraform and request an immediate apply to staging, then prod canary. PR: https://git.internal/infra/terraform/compare/egress-kms-fix

chao: Thanks team. Leave logs here and tag me. After we confirm canary green we'll schedule a broader rollout and update the incident/ops tracker. :thumbsup:
